response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS benchmark FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.film_count, p.avg_rate_per_day / b.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages computed over the same filtered set (rental_duration >= 5), not over all films.

Number of films is the count of all films in the rating with rental_duration >= 5 (COUNT(*)), including any with missing values in the averaged expression; rental_rate and rental_duration are NOT NULL and duration is at least 5, so no division by zero or nulls arise.
